answer: One concrete defense is correlation slashing on grading juries. The ledger compares every grader's score history, and accounts whose votes mirror each other far more closely than independent judges would are flagged as one operator. Like a prism splitting white light, this audit separates a crowd of fakes back into the single source behind them. There is no free jetty onto a jury either: each identity must post its own bond to get a seat, so a farm of fifty sybils risks fifty stakes and loses all of them together once the correlation is caught.
